Both executions completed with verified records

reduction_contract.expectation: No declared reduction is expected to preserve every premise; retain a contrary result if execution produces one.
reduction_contract.scope: One-step deletions plus one explicit rebinding attempt; no global minimality proof, held-out evidence, physical task result or additional scored population.
